description: This file defines the TbPieChart class, a component for rendering pie and doughnut charts with total value display, using ECharts and SVG.js within an Angular project.

classes.name: TbPieChart
classes.description: A class extending TbLatestChart to render pie/doughnut charts with optional total value display, supporting dynamic resizing and styling.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Initializes chart settings, particularly total value color if total display is enabled.

methods.name: prepareLatestChartOption
methods.description: Prepares the chart options including radius, labels, and animation based on current settings and size.

methods.name: afterDrawChart
methods.description: Creates SVG text node for total value display if enabled and renders it.

methods.name: doUpdateSeriesData
methods.description: Updates the chart series data based on current data items.

methods.name: afterUpdateSeriesData
methods.description: Updates total value display styling after series data update.

methods.name: beforeResize
methods.description: Adjusts chart radius before resize if auto-scaling is disabled.

methods.name: afterResize
methods.description: Repositions total value text after resize.

methods.name: renderTotal
methods.description: Renders the total value text in the chart using SVG.js.
